title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2028-01-27) — the window around the January 25-26, 2028 organizational meeting, and the tightest January gate the calendar can produce
source: EST: the Board's own stated blackout rule applied to the Board's own 2028 note, both re-fetched raw this session, with the weekday arithmetic the whole window rests on corroborated by two INDEPENDENT primaries that are not FOMC documents. federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, page stamped 'Last Update: August 19, 2026', fetched direct 2026-09-09) states verbatim below its 2027 panel: 'Note: A two-day meeting is scheduled for January 25-26, 2028. Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it.' The blackout policy states the window 'will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting'. 2028-01-25 is a TUESDAY (computed, not assumed) so the gate opens SATURDAY 2028-01-15; the meeting concludes Wednesday 2028-01-26 so it closes at the end of THURSDAY 2028-01-27. THE WEEKDAY ARITHMETIC IS CORROBORATED TWICE FROM NON-FED AND NON-CALENDAR SOURCES: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200 after its redirect, 109,180 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-09 with a browser User-Agent) prints '—*' in its 2028 New Year's Day cell with the footnote that no New Year's holiday is observed in 2028, which is true only if 2028-01-01 falls on a Saturday; and federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, 'K.8 - Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030') carries 'January 1*' in its own 2028 New Year's row against the Saturday footnote. A Saturday 2028-01-01 makes 2028-01-25 a Tuesday and 2028-01-15 a Saturday. THE DERIVATION VALIDATES 20 OF 20 AGAINST THE JANUARY GATES THIS REPO AND THE BOARD ALREADY HOLD: this session parsed 167 scheduled meetings from federalreserve.gov's 2021-2027 panel plus its fourteen fomchistorical<year>.htm pages 2007-2020 (HTTP 200 each, fetched direct 2026-09-09) — 21 years x 8 less the cancelled 2020-03-17/18 meeting, conference calls, unscheduled meetings and the 2025-08-22 notation vote excluded — and ran the same arithmetic over every January meeting in it, returning 2027-01-16 -> 2027-01-28 exactly as fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16.md's PDF decode carries it and every 2007-2026 January window consistent with the rule. THIS SESSION DID NOT RE-RUN THE PDF DECODE and does not claim to: proposals/fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15.from-fomc-2028-01-26.json was read in full first, its lane inflated federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf's January 2028 page on 2026-09-09 and decoded the shading as 2028-01-15 through 2028-01-27 with the meeting box on 01-25/26 — which matches this session's independent arithmetic to the day, from a different document. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of them date doubt: the meeting it brackets is itself tentative by the Board's own sentence above, and this lane does not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 initial research (2026-09-09), which read the sole prior proposal (from-fomc-2028-01-26) in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md; it is shadowed by this file and left in place. Impact medium matches the family — every fomc-blackout-start-* entry in this calendar is medium. WHAT THIS WINDOW IS, in one line: the FIRST 2028 gate, wrapping the Committee's annual organizational meeting, and a DATE-FOR-DATE REPEAT of the 2011 and 2022 January gates — same Saturday open 01-15, same MLK Monday 01-17 inside, same Tue/Wed meeting 01-25/26, same Thursday close 01-27, same eight sessions. THE STRUCTURAL FACT, measured this session over the 20 realized January gates 2007-2026 against SEC EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 filings (data.sec.gov, HTTP 200 each): a January gate's content is decided by WHERE THE MEETING FALLS IN THE LAST WEEK, and 2028 sits in the emptiest class the calendar can produce. Two company slot rules, both re-derived here rather than assumed: META files its Q4 8-K on the LAST WEDNESDAY OF JANUARY when that day is the 27th or later and in the first week of February otherwise (13 of 14 years 2013-2026), and AAPL has filed on the last Thursday of January when that day is the 27th or later, first Thursday of February otherwise (5 of 5 since 2022). January 2028's last Wednesday is the 26th and its last Thursday is the 27th, so the rules put META OUTSIDE the gate (2028-02-02), AAPL's filing ON the gate's final session 2028-01-27 — after the close, so its price reaction lands Friday 2028-01-28, one session AFTER the gate lifts — and only MSFT's last-Wednesday slot (2028-01-26, the decision day) inside. MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED, that after-close timing: across all Item 2.02 filings since 2007 the mean absolute single-day move is 1.4-2.5% on the filing session and 3.9-8.0% on the NEXT one, for all five mega-caps. THE CONSEQUENCE FOR THE FAMILY'S OWN RULE: fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16.md's headline — size the gate's last session as an event day because it sits inside the Q4 print cluster — is reproduced here on the mega-cap subset (3.25% mean / 2.30% median absolute move per name across the eight gates 2019-2026 against a 1.51% January baseline) but is CONDITIONAL ON THE GATE CLOSING LATE, and 2028 is in the class where it fails. In 2022, the one exact geometric twin with a modern filing calendar, the gate's last session printed 0.42% per name (the minimum of that eight-year sample) and the FIRST POST-GATE session printed 3.73%, because AAPL reported after the close of the last session. WHAT WAS MEASURED AND CAME BACK EMPTY, so nobody re-spends a session on it: the S&P-level overhang premium is 10 of 20 above 1.0x its own January baseline (mean 0.998x, median 1.009x) — a coin flip, consistent with the pooled 82-of-155 null the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 lane established across all gates — and the organizational meeting's own content is already measured inert by fomc-2028-01-26.md (Longer-Run Goals meetings 0.927% vs 0.926%, permutation P = 0.9991; the January class 0.896% vs 0.931%, P = 0.881), cited and not re-derived. symbols is empty. The ONE house-playbook contact, which no sibling has named: S3 (fade the reaction-day open) is a mega-cap reaction-day play with MSFT its strongest leg (59/87 red, p=3.4e-4) — and MSFT's predicted reaction day IS this gate's final session — but S3 is blocked on shorting plus Eric's sign-off, and AAPL is explicitly absent from it. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution and license no entry. Ledger: docs/research/events/fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15.md
